utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you’re free, I’d love your help keeping track of fixes and who can volunteer.

utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rosa — I’m free and happy to help keep track of the fixes and volunteers. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Gus — thank you. I’ll start a list of the repairs and volunteer names, and we can sort priorities when we meet Sunday.

utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Faye — I’ve got Sunday at the community center noted, and I’ll start the availability list now.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. Let me know what’s missing, and I’ll keep an eye out for the rest.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center front entrance. I’ll be there after lunch to help sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — that helps. I’ll keep the time and entrance in mind, and if the plan shifts, let me know so I can pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — that works for me. I’ll stay ready for any updates.

utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the supplies list updated and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll be there at 10 a.m. with an extra set of hands. Just let me know if you need me to bring any tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules — if you can bring any basic hand tools, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — nothing major has changed, we’re still collecting broken items and tools and I’m keeping everyone posted. If you want, I can give you the current assignments in a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
